caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical pottery vessel with thick walls and a wide opening at the top. The vessel is beige-gray in color and features two rounded handles on opposite sides, each handle decorated with blue striped patterns. Around the circumference of the vessel, there are blue painted decorative motifs, including curved and wave-like lines as well as an abstract design on the front. The vessel sits on a plain surface and there are no other objects or background features in the image. The pottery appears to have a slightly rough, textured surface.
